what: A mosaic that builds one big letter out of hundreds of the same small letters. Only the opaque cells of a big letter drawn to fill the sheet are picked at 20px (touch 27px) spacing, and a small letter (30px, touch 27px) is stamped on each cell. Once attached, the small letters start from anywhere in the sheet with a 0~.5s delay and gather into place over 3s power3.out. Letters within a 160px radius of the cursor and of a virtual dot drifting on its own (.35 of the width horizontally and vertically from the sheet center, angular speeds .6·.8) swell by (1 − distance/radius)² up to 4x (touch 3.5x).

options.[data-fx-part=shape]: One large letter (text) to stack as a mosaic — does nothing if missing or empty
options.cell: Small text stamped on each cell, defaults to the same as the large text
options.radius: Radius (px) swelled by cursor and virtual points, default 160
options.max: Max swell multiplier, default 4 · 3.5 on touch
options.gather: Gather duration in seconds, default 3 — 0 snaps into place instantly
options.top: Pins the shape’s top edge this many px from the top of the panel — original 40 (so only the top part overlaps below the hero). If omitted, centered
options.mirror: If 1, flips the canvas left to right (original) — the cursor position is measured flipped too
options.--fx-glyph: Small text color (via style), default is the element text color

from.where: index.js startMv Hero mosaic (original Layout fc() — stamps an SVG path of a kanji onto a canvas, cells 20/27px, text 30/27px, radius 160, max 4/3.5x, 0~.5s delay 3s power3.out, top end 40px, left-right flipped)
from.note: The original draws SVG paths while our part draws text — to use paths, set a font containing those glyphs as --kf-font-display instead of text
